scope: Actual regeneration with all reviewed owned outputs absent, from canonical inputs contained in one fresh full release_candidate archive. No formal/shared changes, no C++ compilation, no performance measurement.
safe_extraction: CRC, unique strict canonical paths and no symlink entries, new absent root.

ownership.fast_source_note: 11 public Fast overrides include10 generator-owned outputs and1 handwritten Node. Node plus3 Internal helpers were retained; no manual Fast source was deleted.
ownership.source_cpp_inputs: NTT.cpp, Matrix.cpp, Dynamic_Bitset.cpp and other manual sources are legitimate canonical inputs. The gate does not claim they can be reconstructed without those sources.
ownership.excluded_utility: Scripts/generate_script.py consumes a user-supplied TOML to emit install.sh/compile.sh; it owns none of these library/archive outputs and is outside this source-regeneration gate.

annotations.source: All83 normal last Submission URLs were already explicit in Verify/current/groups metadata before deleting submissions. Existing judgements retained independently. Profile URL inputs are absent/empty and normal URLs are not copied to profile status.

limitations: Exact frozen release_candidate archive snapshot only. Historical judgement annotations remain historical; regeneration does not assert online AC. No independent algorithm verification is inferred from text identity.
